How it scores

56Fit score 56/100

Beach access2/10
About a 20-minute walk (crossing US-1, the Atlantic Ave drawbridge and A1A) to Delray's wide public beach at Atlantic Ave: just inside the trip's 20-minute limit, far from the rubric's on-sand or short-walk anchors.
Drive to Grandma6/10
About 21-23 min and 10-12 mi by car with no traffic, so typical season traffic puts it just past the 22-minute anchor, well inside the 30-minute limit.
Cleanliness7/10
Category scores are high (Booking.com 8.9, Tripadvisor 4.9) and most 2026 guests call rooms clean or spotless, but worn shower grout, mold sightings and skipped housekeeping recur in late-2025 and 2026 complaints.
Beach chairs & umbrellas1/10
The hotel offers no beach chairs, umbrellas or beach service (its loungers are on the pool deck), so you rent from the concession at the Atlantic Ave beach or bring your own.
Pool5/10
One modest rectangular pool with an attached hot tub on an elevated second-floor deck (marketed as a rooftop pool) with about 20 loungers; guests like it, but there is no evidence it is heated, one Feb 2026 guest says it needs a refresh, and the hot tub jets were broken in Dec 2025.
Condition & newness7/10
Renovated in 2024-25 and described as fresh and modern in 2026 reviews, which points to 9-10, but the 2012 building shows recurring maintenance problems: no room heat in winter 2025-26, old shower-floor tile, AC faults and slow repairs.
Service8/10
Staff scores are high (Booking.com 8.9, Tripadvisor 4.9) and 2026 reviews name many staff (Zoe, Leyla, Vickie, Jariah, Gaelle, Nick, Charles, Janaith, Nicholas); the GM answers reviews, but repairs, room moves and housekeeping lag when the hotel is full.
Quiet6/10
A block off Atlantic Ave, guests call it quiet for the most part, but there's hallway noise from families and teams in season, gaps under some doors, a lobby bar with live music, and the Delray Beach Open crowds downtown through Feb 21.
Walkable dining9/10
In Pineapple Grove a block from Atlantic Ave: Tripadvisor counts 116 restaurants within 0.3 mi (walk grade 94/100), the nearest is a minute away and Atlantic Ave is 4 minutes, but the nearest supermarket is a 16-minute walk.
Host reliability7/10
A branded Hyatt with a 24-hour desk and digital check-in, and no reported cancellations, but 2025-26 reviews report a wrong room type when full, a double charge, a two-hour check-in delay, and listed 'climate control' without heat.

Pros and cons for you

Pros
  • King room with a sofa bed fits the party; rooms redone in the 2024-25 renovation
  • Pineapple Grove location: dozens of restaurants within a few minutes, Atlantic Ave a 4-minute walk
  • Free breakfast every morning
  • Strong reviews: Tripadvisor 4.7, Booking.com 8.6 (cleanliness 8.9, location 9.5)
  • About 21-23 minutes by car to Grandma's place in Boynton Beach
  • Friendly staff named in many 2026 reviews; 24-hour front desk
Cons
  • The beach is about a 20-minute walk over the Atlantic Ave drawbridge, crossing US-1 and A1A: right at your limit
  • No beach chairs, umbrellas or confirmed beach shuttle from the hotel
  • Rooms had no heat in winter 2025-26; the promised heating upgrade is unconfirmed
  • Recurring maintenance complaints: worn shower grout, AC faults, slow repairs
  • Paid self-parking in a garage with a very low ceiling
  • Delray Beach Open weekend (Feb 19-21) and family or team groups make it busy

Nearby

  • Delray Beach public beach (Atlantic Ave entrance at A1A) · 20 min (1.5 km via Atlantic Ave and its drawbridge; chairs and umbrellas rented on the sand.)
  • Atlantic Ave restaurant strip (NE 2nd Ave corner) · 4 min (348 m on foot; Tripadvisor counts 116 restaurants within 0.3 mi of the hotel.)
  • Il Contadino · 1 min (About 200 ft per Booking.com.)
  • Dada and El Camino · 3 min (Per Tripadvisor's nearby list.)
  • The Placery (lobby bar) and breakfast area · 0 min (On site: free breakfast, casual food and cocktails in the evening.)
  • Publix (555 NE 5th Ave) · 16 min (Nearest full supermarket, 1,256 m on foot.)
  • Arts Garage · 1 min (Per Tripadvisor's nearby list.)
  • Delray Beach Tennis Center (0.26 mi per Hyatt, 2,200 ft per Booking.com; the Delray Beach Open runs Feb 12-21, 2027.)
  • Downtown free golf-cart rides (City on-demand service mentioned by a Sept 2026 guest.)

Insider tips

  • Ask for a high-floor king room away from the elevators; a Feb 2026 guest heard kids in the halls before midnight.
  • Check the heat and AC as soon as you get to the room, and ask for a move early in the day: the hotel often runs full in season.
  • The Atlantic Ave drawbridge opens at quarter past and quarter to the hour; allow a few extra minutes on the beach walk.
  • Delray's free downtown golf-cart ride service (guests mention it) is handy for the trip back from the beach.
  • Beach chairs and umbrellas rent at the municipal beach, first come, first served; go early on the Feb 20-21 weekend.
  • Mind the garage's very low ceiling with an SUV or hatchback, and don't cut through the private camera-enforced lot next door at 140 NE 2nd Ave.
  • Check-in 3 pm, check-out noon; minimum check-in age 21.

We couldn’t verify

  • hyatt.com blocks bots; official facts come from a May 2025 Wayback copy and Hyatt's 2012 opening release.
  • The walk is 19-21 min depending on pace (20 used); walk_time.py's 22 min ends at a point past the nearest named entrance.
  • Pool size and whether the main pool is heated aren't published; the 6:30 am-10 pm pool hours are via search snippet.
  • Whether room heating was added for winter 2026-27, as the GM promised in March 2026, is unconfirmed.
  • The renovation year rests on Hyatt's 'newly renovated' May 2025 page and Feb 2025 photo dates; the citybiz article's date wasn't readable (March 2025 via search snippet).
  • Search snippets disagree on a hotel beach shuttle (one says free, another says none); no official source found, so none is assumed.
  • The Tripadvisor count (439), Priceline and Trip.com ratings come from Google's other-sites panel (Oct 2026); the June 2026 Tripadvisor snapshot showed 417.
  • Google review dates are relative ('a month ago') and converted to approximate months.
  • Drive times are free-flow router estimates; February daytime traffic may add several minutes.
  • The restaurant count is approximate (Tripadvisor's 116 within 0.3 mi; a Nominatim search capped at 50 within about 600 m), not a routed 10-minute count.
  • Concierge appears only on Booking.com's amenity list.
  • OpenStreetMap maps a bar (Winehouse Social) at the same street address; whether it operates or is audible from rooms is unknown.
  • Construction near the hotel during Feb 2027 not checked.

Recent trend
Steady and strong: 4.86 from 166 reviews, mostly 5-star through Oct 2026; of the last 20 one is 3-star (Mar 2026, noise and linens). Same-season evidence is good: all seven Feb 2025 and Feb 2026 reviews are 5-star. The Booking.com copy (7.1, 8 reviews) is older and thinner.

Recent reviews, paraphrased (not exact quotes):

  • “Two-week stay: the bed is huge and very comfortable, the space uncluttered, the bathroom clean and the towels soft. A short, pleasant walk to Bryant Park and the Dollar General, and about 10-15 minutes on foot to downtown.”5/5, Airbnb, 2026-09
  • “A few nights; the location is excellent, especially if you want to walk across the bridge to the beach.”4/5, Airbnb, 2026-09

Pros and cons for you

Pros
  • Comfortable king bed (memory foam) that guests praise again and again
  • Superhost Casey (100% response, within an hour) and an Airbnb Guest favorite listing
  • Downtown Lake Ave restaurants and bars 7-10 min on foot; Bryant Park and the Intracoastal one block away
  • Free beach gear to borrow (chairs, umbrella, boogie boards, coolers) and free shared laundry
  • All seven February reviews (2025 and 2026) are 5 stars
Cons
  • Beach is a 20-minute unshaded walk over the Lake Ave bridge: exactly the trip's limit
  • About 30 min typical drive to Grandma's (22-40 min range): the outer edge of the target
  • One of four connected apartments sharing walls; a Mar 2026 guest heard everything from the neighbours
  • Stained linens reported twice in 2026
  • No pool, no reserved parking (free street parking only), window AC units
  • The Booking.com copy of this unit rates only 7.1 from 8 older reviews

Nearby

  • Bryant Park and the Intracoastal · 2 min (One block; waterfront path, playground, boat ramp)
  • Toojays · 7 min (Lake Ave; nearest mapped restaurant)
  • Nature's Way Cafe · 8 min (Lake Ave)
  • South Shores Tavern & Patio Bar · 9 min (Lucerne Ave)
  • Dave's Last Resort & Raw Bar · 10 min (Lake Ave)

  • Publix · 16 min (Nearest supermarket, Dixie Hwy)
  • Lake Worth Beach (Casino and Pier) · 20 min (Over the Lake Ave bridge; lifeguarded; Casino entrance 18-20 min, sand 19-21 min)
  • R.G. Kreusler Park · 20 min (Next public access north of the Casino)
  • Benny's on the Beach · 22 min (On the Lake Worth Pier)

Insider tips

  • Book on Airbnb; the primary guest must be 21+ and send a photo ID within 24 hours of booking.
  • The beach gear is a shared stash by the laundry room for all four apartments; claim chairs and the umbrella early.
  • Bring laundry detergent: the two shared washers and dryers are free but detergent is not supplied.
  • Street parking out front is free with no time limit, but downtown parking is tight on weekends; a Feb 2026 couple took Ubers into town at night.
  • Fri Feb 19 is Lake Worth Beach bonfire night at the Casino from 6 pm, and the host warns guests about weekend street closures downtown.
  • Self check-in by smart lock after 4 pm; checkout 11 am.

We couldn’t verify

  • Minimum stay is not shown on the listing; the 4-night Feb 18-22 stay was bookable on Airbnb at verification.
  • Year built and renovation year are not published (the host's caption only says the bathroom tiles are original 1940s).
  • Number of beach chairs and umbrellas in the shared stash is not stated.
  • Intracoastal bore project dates (late Aug to mid-Nov 2026) are via search snippet; the city page gives only a 90-day duration.
  • OpenStreetMap restaurant counts likely undercount downtown Lake Worth Beach.
  • Google Maps drive times are 'typical' predictions; free-flow routers give 24-28 min.

Eight-room 1936 B&B facing Lake Worth Beach's golf course, with hot breakfast and a king Dali Room; the beach is an 18-minute walk over the bridge.

Best for: A couple who wants a characterful, owner-run B&B with a king room, a cooked breakfast and downtown dinners on foot, and can do without a pool or beachfront.

54Fit score 54/100

Beach access2/10
Not on the beach: Lake Worth Beach by the Casino and R.G. Kreusler Park are a 16-19 minute walk over the Lake Ave bridge, inside the trip's limit but well past an easy stroll.
Drive to Grandma4/10
Google Maps puts a February Thursday-afternoon or Friday-morning drive at typically 20-40 minutes (13.3 mi via I-95), about 30 at the midpoint: right at the 30-minute outer limit, with free-flow routers at 24-27.
Cleanliness8/10
Booking.com guests rate cleanliness 9.1/10 and Tripadvisor 4.9/5, and 2026 guests praise housekeeping; one October 2025 guest found mold on the AC unit and a loose toilet.
Beach chairs & umbrellas5/10
The inn lends beach chairs and beach towels free (Booking.com also lists umbrellas), but nobody sets them up and you carry them 18 minutes over the bridge.
Pool1/10
No pool: the inn's amenities and Booking.com's facility list name a courtyard garden, balconies and in-room whirlpool tubs, but no swimming pool.
Condition & newness6/10
A 1936 house converted in 1997 with no dated room renovation; new owners since January 2024 are upgrading, and reviewers call it lovingly restored, but an October 2025 guest flagged a moldy AC unit, a loose toilet and flooding by the parking.
Service9/10
Owner Jack and his family are named in review after review for warm, personal hosting, cooked breakfasts and afternoon cookies; Booking.com rates staff 9.4 and no recurring service complaint appears in 2025-26.
Quiet6/10
Guests consistently call the inn and courtyard quiet and peaceful, but the Gulfstream Hotel restoration about 110 m south was still unfinished in fall 2026, and the Dali Room faces N Golfview Rd.
Walkable dining7/10
Downtown Lake Worth Beach's Lake Ave and Lucerne Ave strip starts about 6 minutes away, with about a dozen restaurants and pubs within 10 minutes; the nearest supermarket is 13-14 minutes.
Host reliability8/10
An owner-run inn with no reported cancellations, and its own engine lists the Dali Room's king bed accurately; but Booking.com lists its 'King Room' with one queen bed, and a January 2024 guest was locked out during the ownership handover.

Strong and steady since owner Jack Loudon and family took over in January 2024: Booking.com 9.2, Google 4.6 and Tripadvisor 4.8, with January-March 2026 stays (same season) almost all 10/10 on Booking.com; the few 2025-26 dips cite maintenance and a soft bed.

Insider tips

  • Book the Dali Room on the inn's own site: it is the only king room open for Feb 18-22 (the Renoir and Gallery suites are waitlist-only), and Booking.com lists its 'King Room' with one queen bed.
  • Check-in is 3-5 pm; text or call 561-582-1090 if arriving later. Children must be 14 or older (Booking.com says minimum check-in age 21).
  • Park free on the street in front at a 45-degree angle; don't pull into the driveway. N Golfview Rd is one-way southbound between 2nd Ave N and Lucerne Ave, which GPS may miss.
  • Borrow the inn's beach chairs and towels for the walk over the Lake Ave bridge; guests also mention free kayaks and paddleboards for the Intracoastal across the road.
  • Fri Feb 19 is Lake Worth Beach's bonfire night at the Casino from 6 pm.

We couldn’t verify

  • Gulfstream Hotel status: the Sep 2026 contractor firing and end-2026 opening target are known only via search snippet (the article blocks bots); whether work continues in Feb 2027 is unknown.
  • Elevator and the Dali Room's floor are not stated; the inn's ADA statement says the 1930s building has structural barriers to accessibility.
  • Beach umbrellas appear only in Booking.com's facility list, not on the inn's site; the number of beach chairs is not stated.
  • Tripadvisor rating and count (4.8, 231) come from Google Travel in Oct 2026; Tripadvisor sub-scores are from an Aug 2025 Wayback snapshot.
  • Google and Tripadvisor review dates via Google Travel are relative ('4 months ago') and approximate.
  • All Booking.com photos predate the January 2024 ownership change; the official site offers only one full-size property photo.
  • Booking.com review lists show stay month and review date; samples use the review month.

Buyout only: The Lucerne (101 Lucerne Ave) is sold online solely as 'Lucerne Collection Private 4-Unit Building' by manager Stay Hospitality (help@stay-hospitality.com, (954) 526-8998) and on Booking.com; same building confirmed by Booking.com's map pin and identical photos. Bed trap: the 4 units each have ONE queen bed in separate units with their own entrances - no king and no unit with two beds, so the couple would share a queen or split across units. Single units are not sold online: the hotel's own site (lucernelwb.com) has only an enquiry form (it still describes 3 apartments plus a 2-bed/2-bath cottage), so a cheaper single-unit price would have to be requested by email. Direct cancellation terms are not shown before checkout (house rules say the policy is 'outlined in your reservation'); Booking.com's $4,965.22 all-in rate is free to cancel before Feb 13, 2027, about $10 more. Airbnb/Vrbo listings for the buyout were not probed (Vrbo blocked run-wide); the manager's 'Compare Rates' panel only shows estimated OTA mark-ups. Direct book link carries the dates; set guests to 2.

Renovated 1945 four-studio building on Lucerne Ave in downtown Lake Worth Beach, rented whole; the beach is a 20-minute walk over the bridge.

Best for: Two adults happy to sleep in separate studios (or a group of up to 8) who want a walkable downtown base, with the beach a 20-minute walk over the bridge.

Pros and cons for you

Pros
  • The whole renovated building is yours: four private studios with their own entrances, a lobby lounge and a garden patio
  • Downtown Lake Worth Beach restaurants and bars from a 5-6 minute walk
  • 2026 guests consistently praise cleanliness and quick responses
  • Free on-site parking
  • The beach (R.G. Kreusler Park or the Casino and pier) is within the 20-minute walking limit, just
Cons
  • No king and no studio with two beds: each unit has one queen, so you either share a queen or split across two separate units
  • Sold online only as a whole-building buyout for up to 8, far more space than two people need
  • A 20-minute walk to the sand, at the trip's limit, and about 26 minutes by car to Grandma (typically 20-40)
  • No pool, and beach chairs and umbrellas are no longer listed
  • Thin independent reviews: the buyout listing has none, Booking.com shows 7.0 from 6 external reviews, Google 3.5 from 2, and the manager's site shows only 5/5 reviews
  • Self check-in only, with an ID, a signed rental agreement and a card hold required first; no washer and no heating listed
  • The Gulfstream Hotel's planned expansion is about a block away and its construction timing is unverified

Insider tips

  • The four studios are also listed one at a time on Stay Hospitality's site as queen studios for two (for example 'Downtown Studio | Walk to Lake Worth Beach'); if you need separate beds, ask the manager about booking two studios instead of the whole building.
  • Minimum stay is 2 nights; check-in is after 4 pm by smart lock, check-out by 11 am.
  • Send the photo ID and signed rental agreement well before arrival: access instructions are only sent after.
  • Booking.com sells the same buyout with free cancellation until Feb 13, 2027; the manager's site shows cancellation terms only after booking.
  • Walk east on Lake Ave over the bridge: R.G. Kreusler Park is the closest sand (17-19 min), the Casino and pier about 20. Lake Worth Beach holds a bonfire night at the Casino on Fri Feb 19 from 6 pm.
  • Don't confuse it with 'The Lucerne', an unrelated 80-unit downtown condo building completed in 2006.

We couldn’t verify

  • Renovation year not published; the 1945 build year is via search snippet (Realtor.com, LoopNet; pages blocked).
  • Whether beach chairs, umbrellas and bikes are still provided: only the 2022-era hotel site lists them.
  • All 29 reviews on the manager's site are 5/5, which may be filtered; the studios' own Airbnb listings and ratings were not found, and Booking.com's 6 external reviews are not readable.
  • Gulfstream Hotel expansion (adjacent mixed-use building and garage): construction start and whether work will be active in Feb 2027 are unverified.
  • Expedia cross-listing known only via search snippet.
  • The issuing bodies of the Airbnb registration numbers are not stated, and a Florida DBPR licence was not checked.
  • Which studio faces the street (traffic noise) is unknown; Airbnb lists heating and a washer as unavailable.
  • Vrbo not checked (blocked run-wide).

  • Publix, Dixie Hwy · 28 min (Nearest supermarket; easier by car.)

Insider tips

  • Ask for an Intracoastal-side room or a balcony suite: many rooms face the water and the sunsets, while some balconies face the parking lot.
  • Breakfast runs 6:30-9:30 am on weekdays and 7-10 am on Sat-Sun; the pool opens at 7 am.
  • Walking to the beach avoids Kreusler Park's hourly meters, since hotel parking is free.
  • Fri Feb 19 is bonfire night at Lake Worth Beach from 6 pm, right across the street.
  • A 2024 guest recommends the Saturday farmers market at the beach complex next door.
  • Allow extra time to Grandma's at rush hour: Google's typical range runs up to 40 minutes.

We couldn’t verify

  • Last room renovation year is not published; Marriott's current photos show updated decor.
  • Pool length not published; county records give 840 sq ft.
  • That the hotel offers no beach chairs rests on its amenity lists plus a search snippet (via search snippet); not confirmed with the hotel.
  • No construction is announced near the Lake Worth Beach Casino or Kreusler Park for Feb 2027 (via search snippet).
  • Housekeeping frequency in 2026 is unconfirmed.
  • marriott.com blocks bots; official facts come from a March 2026 Wayback snapshot.
  • Tripadvisor count (656) and the Priceline and Marriott ratings come from Google Travel's summary; the Tripadvisor page itself was read from a January 2026 Wayback snapshot (648 reviews).
  • Google review dates are relative ('3 months ago') and converted to approximate months.
  • OSRM routers were unreachable; walks and the free-flow drive used Valhalla, and walk_time.py fell back to straight line x1.3.

  • Before paying, ask the host for the building name, unit number and Florida DBPR vacation-rental licence, and confirm renters can use the private beach and pool.
  • Ask whether the condo association allows a 4-night rental and whether beach chairs and an umbrella are in the unit.
  • Gulfstream Park (4489 N Ocean Blvd, sunrise to sunset) is the nearest public beach entrance.
  • Free cancellation runs until February 11, 2027, which leaves time to vet the host.
  • Deke's in Briny Breezes covers coffee and grocery staples; the Publix on SE 18th Ave is a short drive over the Intracoastal.

Small family-owned 1948 motel, renovated 2016-17, three blocks north of Atlantic Ave; keypad self check-in, no pool, 20-minute walk to the beach.

Best for: A couple who wants a simple, clean base a few blocks from Atlantic Ave and Pineapple Grove and doesn't need a pool or front desk, and accepts a 20-minute walk to the beach.

How it scores

45Fit score 45/100

Beach access1/10
A 17-20 minute walk (conservatively 20, the trip's limit) along US-1 and over the Atlantic Ave drawbridge, crossing A1A, to Delray's public beach: inside the limit but at the rubric's bottom anchor.
Drive to Grandma6/10
About 21-23 min and 10-11 mi by car with no traffic, so typical daytime season traffic puts it a little past the 22-minute anchor, inside the 30-minute limit.
Cleanliness7/10
Booking.com's cleanliness score is 9.2 and most 2025-26 reviews call rooms very clean, but Tripadvisor's is 4.1 of 5 and there are recurring odour, mustiness and bathroom-ventilation complaints.
Beach chairs & umbrellas1/10
The hotel supplies no beach chairs, umbrellas or beach towels on its site or Booking.com amenity list, so you rent from the concession at the Atlantic Ave entrance or bring your own.
Pool1/10
There is no pool: the property is a small motel with two landscaped garden seating areas.
Condition & newness5/10
Renovated in 2016-17, so within about ten years, but several 2026 winter reviews call the rooms bleak and worn with dim light, weak water pressure and sealed windows, and Tripadvisor photos show broken fixtures.
Service6/10
Scores are high (Booking.com staff 9.3, Tripadvisor service 4.4) and guests praise the friendly woman who checks them in and the housekeeper, but nobody is on site around the clock, check-in is by keypad, and some guests found emails cold or couldn't find their room at night.
Quiet6/10
Guests often call it quiet, especially rooms at the back, and Tripadvisor rates sleep quality 4.4, but it sits on US-1, wall A/C units are loud, and some guests mention lights, dogs or neighbours.
Walkable dining7/10
About 31 OSM-mapped restaurants, cafes and bars are within a 10-minute walk, and Pineapple Grove and Atlantic Ave are 7-9 minutes away; only a coffee shop and a couple of places are closer, and Publix is an 8-minute walk.
Host reliability6/10
An established small hotel running since its 2016-17 renovation with no reported cancellations, but recent guests flag fees not shown on Booking.com, photos that flatter the rooms, and the owner has listed the property for sale.

Pros and cons for you

Pros
  • King and two-bed rooms fit the party
  • Pineapple Grove and Atlantic Ave restaurants are a 7-9 minute walk; Publix is 8 minutes
  • About 21-23 minutes by car to Grandma's place in Boynton Beach
  • Booking.com cleanliness 9.2 and many reviews praise comfy beds
  • Small tropical garden property that feels private
  • Free cancellation until 7 days before arrival on the verified room
Cons
  • Beach is a 20-minute walk (the trip's limit) along US-1 and over the Atlantic Ave drawbridge
  • No pool and no beach chairs
  • No staff on site; keypad self check-in
  • Basic, worn furnishings, dim rooms and weak water pressure in several Feb 2026 reviews
  • Parking is paid daily and a registration fee is added
  • On US-1 traffic, with loud wall A/C units
  • The owner lists the property for sale; management could change

Nearby

  • Delray Beach public beach (Atlantic Ave entrance at A1A) · 20 min (Via NE 6th Ave and the Atlantic Ave drawbridge; chairs and umbrellas rented on the sand.)
  • Atlantic Ave restaurant strip (US-1 corner) · 9 min (659 m routed; Gabriella's, The Hampton Social, Le Colonial and Hyde Park Prime nearby.)
  • Pineapple Grove (NE 2nd Ave) · 9 min (Christina's, Papa's Tapas and 3rd & 3rd, across the railway.)
  • Coffee shop across the street · 1 min (Per a Feb 2026 guest; not mapped in OSM.)
  • Publix · 8 min (572 m routed (Booking.com: 1,476 ft).)
  • Delray Beach Tennis Center (About 0.8 mi per Booking.com; Delray Beach Open runs Feb 12-21, 2027.)
  • Free downtown shuttle · 0 min (On-demand rides around downtown Delray (hotel's About page; Booking.com lists a free shuttle).)

Insider tips

  • Ask for a room at the back, away from NE 6th Ave (US-1), for quiet (Feb 2026 guest).
  • Tell the hotel your arrival time and get directions to your room before dark: check-in is by keypad, 4 pm to midnight, with no lobby.
  • Free cancellation ends at 5 pm ET seven days before arrival, when your card is pre-authorized for the stay.
  • The official site lists discount codes for AAA members, Florida residents, returning guests and military (proof required at check-in).
  • The beach walk crosses the Atlantic Ave drawbridge, which opens at quarter past and quarter to the hour; rent chairs at the municipal beach early on the Feb 20-21 weekend.
  • The free downtown Delray on-demand shuttle (the hotel calls it the Downtowner) saves the walk back from Atlantic Ave.
  • Minimum check-in age is 21; check-out 11 am.

We couldn’t verify

  • Room count is not published; a search snippet citing a LoopNet sale listing says 14 rooms (via search snippet), and LoopNet blocks bots.
  • Official photos appear to date from the 2016-17 renovation; Feb 2026 guests say the rooms look worse than pictured.
  • The for-sale page is undated (site footer 2025); whether ownership or management changes before Feb 2027 is unknown.
  • Booking.com's description says free parking, but its amenity list and the hotel's terms say parking is paid daily.
  • Staffed office hours are not published; a 2026 review says no staff on site.
  • Booking.com lists a microwave, but an Aug 2026 guest said there was none.
  • Google review dates are relative ('7 months ago') and converted to approximate months.
  • Drive times are free-flow router estimates without live traffic; February daytime traffic may add several minutes.
  • Restaurant count covers OSM-mapped places only; the coffee shop across the street and The New Vegan are not mapped.
  • Tripadvisor count 141 is from Google's 'reviews on other travel sites' panel (Oct 2026); sub-scores are from the May 2026 Wayback copy (140 reviews).
  • Construction near the hotel during Feb 2027 not checked against city planning sources.

Good to know

Know before you go

The coast from Lake Worth Beach to Delray Beach is mostly A1A condo towers and private homes, with a few beachfront resorts (Eau Palm Beach in Manalapan, Opal Grand in Delray) and small motels and boutiques; the mainland downtowns of Lake Worth Beach, Boynton and Delray's Atlantic Ave add hotels a bridge away from the sand. Mid-February is peak winter season, and Palm Beach County set visitor records in the first half of 2026. Every stay of six months or less pays 12.5% tax (6% state + 0.5% county surtax + 6% county bed tax); beachfront resorts add a resort fee of about $40-50 a night and often paid valet, and Airbnb/VRBO show totals before taxes.

Mid-February: peak season and mild weather
  • February normals at West Palm Beach (1991-2020): highs 76.7°F, lows 60.1°F, 2.63 in of rain for the month, one of the driest of the year.
  • This is the heart of the winter season. Palm Beach County drew a record 6.09 million visitors in the first half of 2026, so book early and expect higher rates and minimum stays.
  • Your Feb 18-22 dates fall inside the Delray Beach Open (Feb 12-21) and on spring training's opening weekend (Feb 19), which add to weekend demand.

Sources: climatecenter.fsu.edu wptv.com delraybeachopen.com crawfishboxes.com

Beach chairs and umbrellas
  • Public beaches have no free chairs. Oceanside Beach Service rents first-come, first-served at the Lake Worth, Boynton and Delray municipal beaches: a two-chair-plus-umbrella setup is $60 a day, or $30 a day per chair or umbrella.
  • Check what a resort fee covers: Opal Grand's $40 fee lists pool towel service but not beach chairs.
  • A hotel or rental that supplies beach chairs and an umbrella saves about $60 a day for two at those rates.

Sources: beachservice.com opalcollection.com

Beach parking is metered and tight
  • Boynton Beach Oceanfront Park (on A1A in Ocean Ridge) charges $3.50 an hour, 7 am-9 pm, for everyone; no back-in parking.
  • Lake Worth Beach keeps 60 beach spaces for resident permit holders only; visitors pay hourly (about $4-4.50 an hour per search snippets).
  • Walking to the beach avoids hourly meters on top of hotel parking, which is not free either (Opal Grand is valet-only at $35 a night).

Sources: boynton-beach.org lakeworthbeachfl.gov opalcollection.com

Man o' war season, not seaweed season
  • Portuguese man o' war wash up mostly November-April, when easterly winds push them ashore. Even beached ones sting; lifeguards fly a purple flag when they're around.
  • Sargassum seaweed mainly arrives in late spring and summer, so it's unlikely in February (search snippets, not a guarantee).

Sources: cbsnews.com

Freshly widened beaches at Ocean Ridge, Boynton and south Delray
  • The Army Corps renourished about a mile of beach south of Boynton Inlet, including Ocean Ridge Hammock Park and Boynton Beach Oceanfront Park, starting March 2026.
  • Delray's south beach, from Hidden Harbor Drive to south of Atlantic Dunes Park, was scheduled for renourishment starting January 2026.
  • Both were timed to finish in spring 2026, before turtle-nesting season, so February 2027 should bring wide, rebuilt beaches rather than dredge pipes (completion not separately confirmed).

Sources: discover.pbc.gov dredgingtoday.com

Drawbridges between the beach and the mainland
  • A barrier-island stay reaches the mainland over Intracoastal drawbridges. The Lantana (East Ocean Ave) and Boynton (Ocean Ave) bridges open on the hour and half-hour; Delray's East Atlantic Ave bridge opens at quarter past and quarter to.
  • Allow a few extra minutes on the drive to Grandma's place in Boynton Beach if you hit an opening.

Sources: law.cornell.edu

Booking a vacation rental here
  • Florida requires a DBPR vacation-rental licence for a condo or house rented to the public for short stays; ask for the licence number if a listing doesn't show it.
  • Palm Beach County also requires each short-term listing to hold a county tourist development tax account and business tax receipt; the host, not Airbnb, collects the 6% bed tax.
  • Many A1A properties are condos whose association rules can restrict or forbid short stays even when the town allows them; check the minimum stay and building rules before booking.

Sources: www2.myfloridalicense.com airbnb.com pbctax.gov

Hotel booking tips
  • Some resorts require the person booking to be 21 or older and set 4 pm check-in and 11 am check-out (Opal Grand).
  • Changing dates or room type can trigger new minimum-stay rules in season, so book the exact Thu Feb 18-Mon Feb 22 dates you want.

Sources: opalcollection.com

Taxes and fees

Taxes are typically about 12.5%. Whole-home rentals pay about 12.5% in taxes. Whole-home rentals of 182 nights or less pay the same 12.5% as hotels: Florida 6% transient rental tax + Palm Beach County 0.5% school surtax (both remitted to the state) + Palm Beach County 6% tourist development tax, all on the listing price including cleaning. Airbnb collects the state 6% and the surtax itself, but in Palm Beach County the host must collect and remit the 6% tourist development tax, so an Airbnb checkout may show only ~6.5% in taxes, with the 6% bed tax billed separately by the host or folded into the price. Vrbo reportedly works the same way (search snippet, unverified). The county's 1% infrastructure surtax ended 31 Dec 2025, so pages quoting 13% are out of date. Resort fees run about $40 a night where charged.

12.5% on the room rate is the floor for every hotel and rental all-in (Florida DOR TIP 25A01-15, Dec 2025: 6.5% state+local sales tax from 1 Jan 2026; Palm Beach County Tax Collector: 6% bed tax on top). US hotels add no service charge on rooms. Beachfront resorts add a nightly resort fee (Opal Grand $40, confirmed on its policy page; Eau Palm Beach about $50 and Delray Sands about $45 per search snippets, unverified); limited-service and chain hotels often charge none. Parking is extra and not part of the all-in: Opal Grand is valet-only at $35/night plus tax.

Every price on this page already includes each place’s own taxes and fees, so totals compare like for like.

Sources: floridarevenue.com pbctax.gov airbnb.com airbnb.com opalcollection.com

The fine print

How we scored and what to double-check

  • Prices and availability checked Oct 16, 2026. Rates and rooms change often, so confirm the live price for Feb 18–22, 2027 before booking.
  • Prices are all-in totals for 4 nights, from our live checks only. Older research prices were never shown and were removed where they disagreed.
  • Who made the list: hotel, resort, condo resort, boutique hotel, all-inclusive, whole-home rental, no more than a 20-minute walk from Public beach entrances, Lake Worth Beach to Delray Beach, sleeping 2 adults, and drive to grandma of at least 4/10.
  • Fit score (10–100): each place gets 10 scores from 1 to 10, judged against what you asked for. The fit score is 10 × their weighted average: beach access 14%, drive to grandma 14%, cleanliness 11%, beach chairs & umbrellas 9%, pool 9%, condition & newness 9%, service 9%, quiet 9%, walkable dining 9%, host reliability 9%.
  • Best value for the money: no other qualifying place with rooms confirmed is both cheaper all-in and a better fit.
  • Review snippets are paraphrased, not exact quotes. Ratings are shown on each site’s own scale, with a 10-point equivalent; we never average across sites.

What you asked for

Must have
  • No more than a 15-20 minute walk to a public beach entrance
  • Within a 15-30 minute Uber of Grandma's place in Boynton Beach
  • A king bed or two beds in the room
  • Good reviews

How we checked availability

For each place we searched for your exact stay, Thu Feb 18 to Mon Feb 22, 2027, for 2 adults, on each place’s own booking site, Expedia, Vrbo, Airbnb, Google Hotels, another booking site, Booking.com and rental managers’ own sites. A place counts as bookable only if a site showed a public rate for every night (no codes, memberships, loyalty or package rates) and we saved a screenshot showing both dates and the price. The price shown is the cheapest such rate, all-in: room, taxes, service charges and any resort, cleaning or platform fees. We compare all-in totals, never pre-tax nightly rates, because fees differ a lot between places. Places we couldn’t confirm, and sold-out ones, are never top picks or best value, and the table hides them unless you untick “Only places with rooms for your dates”.

Checked live: 285 places. Rooms can sell out at any time, so book soon after reading this.
